name: memvora
description: Engineering memory for developers, teams, and assistants
author: harshitgupta31415

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.start:local: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api "npm run start --workspace=@memvora/web -- --hostname 127.0.0.1" "npm run start --workspace=@memvora/api"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@memvora/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@memvora/core && npm run build --workspace=@memvora/db && npm run build --workspace=@memvora/enrichment
scripts.build:services: npm run build --workspace=@memvora/api && npm run build --workspace=@memvora/worker && npm run build --workspace=@memvora/cli && npm run build --workspace=@memvora/mcp
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:services && npm run build --workspace=@memvora/web && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: eslint apps/api apps/worker apps/cli apps/mcp packages scripts && npm run lint --workspace=@memvora/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run format:check
